fundamentals.pe_assessment: Frozen October 6 snapshot: trailing P/E 9.58 x, forward P/E 10.25 x (vendor estimate), dividend yield 5.62% (vendor reported). Inference: cash coverage and core improvement support value/income at 9.58 x; adjusted core earnings used with reconciliation caution.
fundamentals.margin_analysis: FY26 revenue RM69.467 bn -0.8%, reported owners profit RM1.762 bn -14.5%. Issuer adjusted core net profit RM1.55 bn +32.6% and core ROE8% vs 6.2% indicate improvement beyond disposal effects; core is management-defined, not reported IFRS profit. FY26 MVV disposal gain RM434 m vs RM901 m explains part of the reported decline, while impairments/provisions remain material.
fundamentals.debt_analysis: Borrowings RM6.385 bn vs RM7.122 bn; cash/deposits RM2.794 bn, lease liabilities RM2.169 bn and perpetual sukuk RM1.181 bn separately classified as equity. CFO RM3.511 bn, cash fixed-asset purchases RM1.085 bn yield simple FCF RM2.426 bn. After finance costs 371 m and lease repayments 608 m, cash surplus 1.447 bn covers shareholders dividends 886 m; distributions to NCI438 m and sukuk 70 m reduce headroom.
fundamentals.growth_outlook: Inference: declining bank debt, positive cash coverage, management-defined core growth and 9.58 x trailing earnings/5.62% reported yield support a value/income return thesis. Board expects FY27 core performance broadly consistent with FY26, not another 32.6% growth guarantee.
key_risks: Reported earnings declined; Motors restructuring impairments and subdued sector demand persist.
Core results exclude items by management definition; perpetual sukuk/NCI distributions constrain cash available to ordinary shareholders.
key_strengths: Debt reduced and cash generation covers fixed-asset investment, interest, leases and observed ordinary dividends.
Core profit/ROE improved, with declared 14 sen FY26 dividend at a modest frozen earnings multiple.
fundamentals.summary: Sime offers a constructive value/income thesis backed by reduced borrowings, cash generation and improved management-defined core profitability. Buy/medium recognizes reported-profit weakness and cyclical risks rather than extrapolating disposal gains or core growth.
